name: Creator
description: High-energy portfolio for content creators, artists, and digital storytellers — social stats, content showcase, brand collaborations, and audience engagement metrics front and center.
designNotes: The Creator template speaks the language of digital audiences: warm amber and red tones evoke energy and engagement over near-black backgrounds. Social stats (followers, views, engagement rate) are first-class citizens, not afterthoughts. The content showcase section uses a grid optimized for video thumbnails and blog post previews. Brand collaboration logos scroll in an infinite marquee, establishing credibility at a glance. Plus Jakarta Sans brings a friendly, approachable confidence that matches the creator economy's tone.
